description: Bounded Instagram numeric-visual (probability trend card) profile. AI art direction and deterministic factual rendering are separate lanes. Reuses the SUE-565 brand/profile lane, SUE-628/SUE-667 deterministic infographic evidence lane and the existing visual-review infrastructure. Implementation (data contract, interpolation, renderer) is owned by SUE-1331 in prediction-market-crawler.

must_not: change or invent numbers, dates, quotes, sources, coverage or market conditions

deterministic_rendering.rule: the chart is generated by code from raw observations; an image model never draws or re-draws data geometry

palette.provider_color_rule: cobalt and coral identify Polymarket and Kalshi only; no other provider may use them

watermark.rule: off unless requested; when enabled: non-empty declared text, behind the plot, opacity 0.05..0.09

title_origin.rule: title is per-request AI-lane editorial output; deterministic lane only displays it; numbers must be grounded

on_image_source.rule: footer source shows the provider/site name only; full URL and run provenance go in the bundle/caption

axis.rule: full 0-100 by default; zoom = [floor5(min-padding), ceil5(max+padding)] widened to min_span, clamped to 0..100; a zoomed axis must say so and show its range; dual uses one shared axis

comparison.related_rule: related-but-not-exact markets are labeled separately, never merged or called exact

approval.illustrative_rule: a fictional-data mockup must be visibly labeled illustrative and never counts as factual or production approval
